description: This file implements the core logic of the 'son_slave_thread' class for a wireless agent in a multi-AP framework. It handles agent initialization, configuration reading, message processing (including IEEE 1905.1 and proprietary messages), state management, timers, and communication with other system components such as broker, platform, and backhaul managers. It largely manages the slave thread's lifecycle, FSM, message parsing, and interactions with radio and control components.

classes.name: slave_thread::sSlaveState
classes.description: Struct managing the current and maximum slave states with an overloaded assignment operator that updates agent database status accordingly.

methods.name: operator=(
methods.description: Overloaded assignment operator for sSlaveState that updates the current and max states and logs the agent state.

methods.name: slave_thread::slave_thread
methods.description: Constructor initializing the slave thread, setting up radio interfaces, configuration, and internal state.

methods.name: slave_thread::thread_init
methods.description: Initializes the thread, including logging, setting up broker clients, CMDU server, timers, and tasks.

methods.name: slave_thread::agent_reset
methods.description: Resets the agent's state, manages retries, and handles stopping.

methods.name: slave_thread::read_platform_configuration
methods.description: Reads configuration data from platform-specific sources and stores in the agent database.

methods.name: slave_thread::platform_notify_error
methods.description: Sends an error notification to the platform manager.

methods.name: slave_thread::on_thread_stop
methods.description: Handles thread stop event by stopping the slave thread.

methods.name: slave_thread::handle_client_disconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection events, resets configurations as needed.

methods.name: slave_thread::fsm_all
methods.description: Runs the finite state machine for agent and radio management, including heartbeat checks.

methods.name: slave_thread::handle_cmdu
methods.description: Processes incoming CMDU messages, dispatching to specific handlers based on message type.

methods.name: slave_thread::handle_cmdu_from_broker
methods.description: Handles CMDU messages received from the broker, forwarding or processing as appropriate.

methods.name: slave_thread::handle_cmdu_control_ieee1905_1_message
methods.description: Processes IEEE 1905.1 control messages and dispatches internal handlers.

methods.name: slave_thread::handle_cmdu_ap_manager_ieee1905_1_message
methods.description: Handles IEEE 1905.1 messages from the AP manager, forwarding if unhandled.

methods.name: slave_thread::handle_cmdu_control_message
methods.description: Handles control messages specific to the agent, including ARP, channel switching, monitoring, and client management requests.

methods.name: slave_thread::process_client_association
methods.description: Processes client association notifications, handles MLO and legacy clients, updates agent database accordingly.

methods.name: slave_thread::handle_cmdu_ap_manager_message
methods.description: Handles messages from the AP manager, including notifications, status, and configuration commands.

methods.name: slave_thread::update_vaps_type
methods.description: Updates the VAP types and labels in the internal database based on incoming data.

methods.name: slave_thread::add_agent_ap_mld_configuration_tlv
methods.description: Adds the Agent MLD configuration TLV to a CMDU message based on the current agent database configuration.

methods.name: slave_thread::add_backhaul_sta_mld_configuration_tlv
methods.description: Adds the Backhaul STA MLD configuration TLV to a CMDU message based on the current database configuration.

methods.name: slave_thread::add_eht_operations_tlv
methods.description: Adds EHT operations information TLV for radios supporting EHT, including BSS and radio entries.

methods.name: slave_thread::send_event
methods.description: Sends internal events such as controller discovery or early AP capability detection to respective tasks.
